description: Dungeon of Dark - is a turn-based game about the dungeon with all sorts of enemies, objects and items. Choose a hero and explore the dungeon. Fight many enemies on the 3x3 battlefield and defeat bosses. Use items wisely.

title: Divisadero
description:
Disgraced police detectives seek redemption as they unravel the clues to a horrifying crime in a ruined, dystopian San Francisco.

Explore a map of real San Francisco Bay Area landmarks and locations, recently destroyed by environmental disaster and war. Learn the city's history and people. Hunt the perpetrators before they strike again. Uncover your own backstory.

title: Flappy Hypership Out of Control
description: Space is a dangerous placed for even the most seasoned and flappy starship pilot when you your accelerator is stuck to the floor and your brakes are out. Can you survive long enough to get that elusive high score or are you destined to add a new crater to the face of an unsuspecting wall?

title: Fatal Evidence: The Missing - Collector's Edition
description: Can you clear an innocent man’s name in time?

title: No Plan B
description: Carefully plan your team's tactics in close quarters battles. Use the timeline to synchronize each door breach, grenade throw and room entry with precision. Watch your team execute your plan autonomously in epic cinematic replays. Take on challenging roguelike campaigns or standalone missions.

title: The Outbound Ghost
description: The Outbound Ghost is an adventure RPG about helping ghosts ascend to the afterlife. Battle the past using figments of your personality. Craft badges to earn abilities. Explore a town of troubled spooks and discover life can be tough, even when you're dead.

title: The Chronicles of Robin Hood - The King of Thieves
description: Join forces with Robin Hood in this thrilling match3 game...! Help Robin Hood and the Merry Men in their quest to take down the Sheriff of Nottingham!

title: I wanna be the Yin-Yang orb
description: This is a well-designed barrage labyrinth game. Incorporates the setting of the unlimited challenge of the I wanna series. You will be teleported to the nearest archive point when hit by the barrage. And you can reborn for unlimited times.

title: This will not go well
description:
In a calm and vast black void, your peaceful journey is abruptly shattered when your spaceship's alarm blares with flashing red lights. Having accidentally triggered a nearby planet's defense system, you find yourself framed as a hostile intruder. Trapped inside your vessel, you must perform desperate, evasive maneuvers to dodge a relentless barrage of incoming homing missiles coming straight for you.

This Will Not Go Well is an intense survival arcade game where you control the spaceship to outmaneuver incoming projectiles. Your objective is simple: survive as long as possible by baiting missiles to collide with one another to score points. When a hazard breaches your ship's surrounding 'Danger Zone', time slows down, giving you a clutch moment of bullet-time focus to dodge fatal impacts and maximize your high score.

title: Cross Soul
description: A girl who is "one person in two bodies" challenging a mystery dungeon. Items that can be transmigrated to change their form as well as spirit weapons. The story of a soul that spans the ages. And... tasty bananas.

title: Space Otter Charlie
description: Adorable characters? Check! Makeshift weapons? Check! Otter dressed in a foam shark suit. Umm. Check? Join Charlie and his ragtag team of sea mammals as they jump, float, and rocket through Otter Space in this Zero-G Puzzle Platformer!

title: Mini Railway
description:
Delisted game from Steam that descrived itself as:

Build and design your railways!

Mini Railway is a railway simulation game, and your goal is to transport various goods to its destinations.

-Select station to start creating railways to connect stations
-Then create new route of track.
-Put the train on the route of track.
-You can add or remove carriages and accelerate the train to improve transportation efficiency.

Try your best to design your mini railways.

title: Inside the Mirror
description: Yumi was just another normal girl living happily together with her family. Now, her family has fallen apart, and Yumi finds it difficult to stay motivated in her day-to-day life, crushed by a growing well of darkness, slowly consuming her from the inside out.

title: Pureya
description: Pureya is a different game every 10 seconds! Collect marbles and use them in the pachinko to unlock new minigames, music, and skins.

title: Modest Hero
description: The violent clashes in the suburbs ended as a result of the military's harsh interventions. During the clashes, a general was killed brutally by a group of rebels. Seven people suspected of killing the general were arrested in next morning.

title: Underzone
description: Search - Rescue - Survive - Smash walls, shoot enemies, rescue survivors, upgrade your Mole Mech, and uncover a dark conspiracy within a 22nd century disaster zone. Underzone is a new twist on the 'roguelite' genre, featuring procedural enemies built out of unique combinations of components.

title: Kainga
description: Kainga is a ancient fantasy village builder where your environment affects your culture, technology and strategy. Advance and adapt to the pressures of the climate, beasts and other tribes.

title: Resistance TD
description: Build defense towers, manage your economy and resist the enemy!

title: Historica Fantasia
description: As an unnamed Dishonored Prince, you rescued your wrongfully convicted sister from the crime of assassinating her Father, the late Emperor. As a Commander of your retinue, you'll lead your sister across the continent to reclaim her place on the Imperial Throne.

title: Ball of Doom
description: Roll, bounce, and destroy your way through an expansive world packed with over 27,000 destructible objects. Unlock hidden skins, set a new highscore, and crush everything standing in your way. With one life per run, each rampage could end at any moment.

title: Lammana: The Looe Island Mystery
description: Journey to Lammana, through the historic 'found footage' of William H Boston. Explore the cursed island off Cornwall's coast. Retrace the steps of a young man who disappeared in 1924. 'Play through' surviving footage to discover a dark mystery involving treasure, exploration and sea monsters.

title: Doudy
description: Dare you play this game? Doudy and disturbing, dark and horrible. A realistic puzzle simulator with photorealistic graphics

title: Cryptic Rooms
description: A series of 3 VR escape rooms, Eye Eaters Basement, Dungeon of Demise, and Inescapable Hypercube. You must navigate through and solve puzzles, each room with its own unique theme and hidden relics that can be found and collected.

title: Legacies
description: Sabotage illegal fish poachers. Save dying coral reefs. Stand in the way of the destruction of the oceans! Somewhat legally!

title: Crowalt: Traces of the Lost Colony
description: A young adventurer Hugh Radcliff is in pursuit of one of the greatest mysteries of history: The Lost Colony. Deal with pirates, dive into native rituals, reveal conspiracies, and make tough choices on your difficult journey for unveiling this mystery!

title: XRacer 2: Evolution
description: XRacer 2: Evolution is a fast car racing game with a completely physics-based driving experience!

title: Gone: Survival
description: Gone Survival is a first-person survival game for one player. Where you have many opportunities and a completely open world

title: Four Rendezvous
description: Hero meets a mysterious girl in the park. Who is that girl? What is a mystery surrounding her? And what about the world they met in? There's definitely something wrong with it. So many questions! So the hero has to deal with all of it to find his love.

title: Sayonara Electric
description: This is an Interactive Adventure and Visual Novel Game depicting life on a lunar base. All texts are performed by Japanese Voice Actors. On a wall-mounted electronic calendar"IMPORTANT!" is flickering. (what's my plan today?) "Today is Christmas Eve." The date shown on the calendar is

title: Grave of the Petrified
description: Set in an ancient Greek temple where Medusa has been sneaking around for centuries, petrifying whoever crosses her path, the player will go through a spine-tingling escape experience.

title: PhaseWorm
description: PhaseWorm is a fast-paced 2D timing and reflex game built with a speedrunning focus. Players will be challenged to think and act quickly as they push for faster times and more difficult paths through each of the game's 30 unique thematic stages.

title: Aria Disconnect
description: Aria Disconnect is a 16-bit action-adventure. You are the protagonist Heri and you are going to follow the journey of his life crisis. The year is 2082, you are hooked to a machine, and there is only one way out, to disconnect.

title: Linda & Joan
description: Linda & Joan is a narrative game about a British family. You play as Russell, Linda, and Joan — son, mother, and grandmother — switching between them to help the family cope with a series of traumatic events. Based on a true story.

title: Warehouse Tycoon
description: Warehouse Tycoon is a business management game in which you control all parts of your warehouse: Buying/selling products, designing your warehouse, managing employees, and most importantly making a profit.

title: Cyberception
description: Fast-paced, brutal, cyberpunk FPS shooter game. Fight for your right to exercise free will again. Fight through hordes of mindless crooks of the Corporation to reach the executive floor and put an end to contract they put on your head. There will be blood and pieces of neuro fiber everywhere.

title: Fantamal
description: It's a Stardew Vallley-meets-Pokemon experience! Build habitats, catch Fantamals, collect their produces and test their combat potential on battles to earn credits at college. Explore the universe to discover and learn about different Fantamals in different towns.

title: Lusitania
description: Welcome aboard the RMS Lusitania, a luxurious ocean liner sunk by a German U-boat during World War 1. Immerse yourself in this detailed unique experience of how this great liner met its final moments.

title: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War
description: Victory and Glory: The American Civil War is a game of grand strategy and fast-play tactical battles where you take the role of either the Union or the Confederates and attempt to win.

title: Henchman For Hire
description: Henchman for Hire is a VR game designed by students where you drive, jump and sabotage Peace City for the super villain Dr. BAD while traveling on a surprisingly resilient moped!

title: Sagrada
description: A game of dice drafting and window crafting. Take turns selecting colorful dice and placing them in your gorgeous stained-glass window. The artisan who creates the most beautiful window wins.

title: Revel Rousers
description: Rampage through a boring city turning boring people into party animals to throw the biggest party for your party god!

title: Lonecastle
description: Lonecastle is a top-down shooter where the player attempts to survive countless enemies. Defend your little castle from the incessant waves of enemy ships and soldiers. Collect gold and gain experience to improve your castle.

title: Remnants of the Dawn
description:
Click-to-move play style. Remnants of the Dawn is a post-apocalyptic dungeon crawler with a focus on exploration. Fight your way through dark laboratories full of killer creatures and massive boss battles. 
 
Dialogue and story-rich. A character-driven story experience, we follow the mission of a group of survivors living a hunter-gather existence since societies collapse. Now they must gather strength for their greatest battle. 
 
Character Upgrade System. As a survivor, Jack, use 'Essence Shards' to become stronger and faster. Choose how to spend them to upgrade your stats as you descend through the ever increasingly difficult labyrinthitis. 
 
Progressive Overworld Village. Explore the Village and get to know the many characters. The people you encounter will give you insight and help you navigate your journey for rich and rewarding gameplay.

title: The Forest Cathedral
description: The Forest Cathedral is a first-person psychological thriller set on a remote island. Playing as scientist Rachel Carson, players will slowly uncover the effects of DDT by using advanced environmental technology to solve 2D/3D connected puzzles in this dramatic retelling of Silent Spring.

title: Super Cute Alien
description: 1-4 players platformer about friendship, love and what it means to be human. Adventure, action and puzzles, contrasting cute and gore effects, also including RPG elements.

title: Amendium
description: Join Axel and Lance in a full-scale quest to discover what happened to the planet they find themselves on. Journey through 3 seas and into many dungeons in search of answers as both Axel and Lance.

title: Isle of Pan
description: Isle of Pan: A Photography Adventure. Explore a mysterious island in the North Sea with an instant camera and guided by a magical book. Photograph the animals, cryptids, and strange beings inhabiting the island to unlock pocket portals to other realms.

title: Wanderlust: Transsiberian
description: Board the Trans-Siberian railroad and travel 9,289 km from Moscow to Vladivostok. Clash with a vibrant culture as you meet people as strange to you as you are to them. Journey into a standalone Wanderlust adventure from the makers of The Witcher.

title: Super No Crying in Baseball
description: An endless baseball rogue-like where you play baseball and manage your emotions at the same time.

title: Stress explosion
description: It's time to explode the massive amount of stress that has accumulated in you! By destroying them, messing them up and blasting them, This is a 2D action game with a refreshing feeling of destruction in various everyday situations. Save this world from stress! !

title: In Plain Sight
description: An emotional and impactful story set in modern America among residents of a trailer park who struggle not only with their economic situation but also with a net of mysteries and secrets.

title: Car Crush Racing Simulator
description: A unique mix of racing, dancing and survival games in one. Extremely dangerous car crusher machines are in action. Compete with your rivals while dodging the car crushing engines.

title: Dingleberries
description: Dingleberries is a VR game where you have no legs. Instead, use your fists to walk, jump and punch. Fight in multiplayer brawl or practice your skills in singleplayer time trials.

title: Sphere: Flying Cities
description: Sphere – Flying Cities is a sci-fi citybuilding game which combines strategy, simulation and survival elements in an extraordinary and immersive scenario. In the aftermath of the moon‘s explosion you need to rise to the challenge! Take over control of the very first flying city ascending from Earth!

title: Nations At War Digital
description: Nations At War series is a dynamic platoon-level combat computer game based on the award-winning board games of the same series name. Nations At War series centered on armor, artillery and infantry combat during World War 2.

title: Knight's Retreat
description: A chess game without any chess. Rearrange your troops to bring your best Knights back to your Kingdom in an abstract medieval world.

title: Titan Chaser
description: Car. Foggy night. Mystical landscapes. And if you want to work - titans. Titan Chaser is a surreal driving and walking experience, where your job is to scout giant creatures and use the light to drive them off without fighting or killing.

title: Watch Me Stream My Mental Breakdown
description: Get rich by playing games all day or die trying. In this Story Card Game you'll get to experience what streaming is REALLY all about.

title: EleMetals: Death Metal Death Match!
description:
EleMetals: Death Metal Death Match is a chaotic explosion of demonic local-multiplayer mayhem! Summon one of SIX metalheads with elemental powers and SHRED YOUR FRIENDS in this kick-ass Arcade-like Experience! Requires 2-4 Players - Great for Steam Remote Play!

PULL YOUR EMERGING SOUL TO SURVIVE!
How badass is your button-mashing?? Frantically return your soul to your corpse - though it gets harder each time you die! Don't let your soul leave the Realm, or you'll be Banished from the round.

SUPER FLUID & VERSATILE DASH MECHANIC
Change Direction, Curve, Hover - Dash into enemies to Destroy them, Dash into Shards to deflect them back, or Dash through traps to avoid death! You’re a demon ffs!

YOU'RE GONNA DIE. A LOT.
Deadly realms, Scrolling levels, Unique Traps, and GIGANTIC GODDAMN LAVA TRIDENTS!

Deadly Features!
- CHUCK METAL SHARDS and HEADBANG FOR AMMO!
- PULL YOUR EMERGING SOUL & REVIVE!
- SUPER-FLUID DASH MECHANIC!
- BIG 'OL CHARGED-UP ATTACKS!
- GIGANTIC GODDAMN LAVA TRIDENTS!!
- 6 DEMONIC METALHEAD CHARACTERS!
- 30 PLAYABLE LEVELS ACROSS 3 REALMS OF PAAAAIN!
- REACTIVE METAL SOUND EFFECTS! created by FAT BARD!

title: Phasmophobia
description: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

title: PiraCrash!
description: Unique PVP Shooter! Train, gain skill and sink your friends on this E-Sport Game! Awesome for a party, perfect for you and for your friends!

title: Aquamarine
description: A quiet survival adventure about perception and discovery in an alien ocean. Explore a planet reclaimed by nature. Cultivate new life to survive. Journey into unknown depths. Find your way home.

title: Deeply Dark: Found Footage
description: WARNING: This is not a game, this software was found on the Deep Web and contains interactive material about the phenomenon of backrooms, we have received numerous reports of fatal accidents after its use, many claim that it is cursed so we cannot guarantee your safety.

title: Kessler Effect
description: “Kessler effect” is the interactive adventure movie in the virtual reality, where the viewer directly interacts with the famous actors. The viewer himself might be one of the main characters and can influence the plot development and the movie ending.

title: Plant Revenge
description: Take revenge for what scientists made with your girlfriend.

title: There Is No Game: Jam Edition 2015
description: A little game that's not a game, winner of an old game jam that nobody's ever heard of.

title: Draw a Stickman: Epic 3
description: Your creativity will be maximized in the all-new Draw a Stickman: EPIC 3! Embark upon an exhilarating new adventure to defeat the Corruption: solve fun puzzles, outsmart crafty monsters, and discover an all-new world! So grab your freshly penciled Hero—it’s time to be EPIC!

title: Pharao Reloaded
description: In Pharao Reloaded you find yourself in the maze of an Egyptian pyramid full of treasures, monsters and potions. Each pyramid is more difficult than the previous one. Can you find the exit in time before the pyramid kills you? How far will you come?

title: Moonlight Mansion
description: A mother and her son uncover the mystery shrouding the manor in which they are imprisoned. To escape, they need to cooperate without letting panic take over, while the manor – or what haunts it – tries to separate them. In this suspenseful game, will you be able to accept the truths revealed to you?

title: Space Chef
description: Hunt down strange alien creatures and plants, then cook 'em! Deliver your tasty creations to the galaxy's most unsafe places on your homemade star scooter. In a quirky mix of exploration, cooking and action, you’ll rebuild your mysteriously destroyed kitchen using nothing but junk and scrap parts.

title: Eira: Echoes of Adventure
description: Eira: Echoes of Adventure is a casual adventure game where you play as Eira and trace your grandfather’s footsteps to journey through an icy world filled with curious alien wildlife, spatial puzzles, and hoards of treasure.

title: Infinite Abyss
description: Infinite Abyss is a combination of a dynamic game of action with strategic elements in a stylized 2D world. You will play the role of the last living astronaut to survive on a lonely planet.

title: Aliens Love Beefs
description: Aliens are hungry and they would LOVE to have a bite of some tasty Beef. Abduct the Beefs on each planet avoiding ammo, explosions and lasers. Casual indie Virtual Reality game using cool spherical gravity game mechanics.

title: FierceWind Decay
description: Endless guidance, endless reincarnation

title: 4 Minutes to the Apocalypse
description: Explore the sinister space of the Arizone-12 submarine, Discover the secret of events happened on a submarine during a nuclear war, Fight with weapons and surrounding objects, look for hiding places. Try not to get killed and take control of the submarine

title: Damn Dolls
description: You are Suzi and your best friend Ana is missing.The only evidence you have is: That Ana was seen near an abandoned house in the forest and the former owner of the property was killed by local residents for being accused of kidnapping and killing a girl.Enter the house and solve this mystery!

title: New Gunbound
description: Casual Action Shooting! In New Gunbound, you will be able to ride your favorite Mobile, explore diverse regions, and battle together with your friends. Play the traditional "Turn" mode or try the new "Realtime" mode. Aim carefully and think strategically then victory will be yours!

title: Gladiators: The Unconquered
description: Seize the mantle of Champion, master your class, and brutalize opponents in an ever-changing arena filled with weapons and traps. Teams face off in gladiatorial combat to determine who will become the god of the arena.

title: Get Good by Vypur
description: A tough, skill based precision 2.5D platformer that will push you to your limits. Can you get good?

title: Intemporel
description: Players control a Guardian who takes the decision to leave the monastry to try to understand what is happening to this collapsing world and why not, try to invert the trend and preserve the world from the evil that is corroding it. Among all the possbilities, will you succeed to find your way ?

title: Tri6: Infinite
description: Tri6: Infinite is a fast-paced endless runner in the Tri6 universe. Avoid the obstacles as long as possible, beat the top scores from other players and unlock new vehicles and power-ups.

title: Runpuzzle
description: RunPuzzle is a puzzle with colorful graphics and various levels. Test your attentiveness and reaction speed in this exciting adventure.

title: Mail Mole
description: Mail Mole is a charming 3D platformer featuring Molty, the fastest delivery mole, in his quest to save Carrotland from disaster! Explore magical worlds, make new friends, race against Mecha-Moles, find collectibles, solve puzzles and deliver awesomeness to the end of the world!

title: The House of Da Vinci 2
description: The long awaited sequel to The House of Da Vinci is finally here. Join more than 1.000.000 players from around the world and dive into the 3D puzzle adventure.

title: SpellPunk VR
description: In SpellPunk you will unleash extraordinary powers and turn into a mighty magician who will cast spells by drawing magical symbols in the air with his/hers own hands. And yes, you will be immersed in a stunning, abstract world, experiencing fast-paced magical duels.

title: Team up with A Magician
description: The orc magician who came down from the sky ended my lonely life. However, my peaceful daily life was also disturbed.

title: SpelunKing: The Mine Match
description: Dig into this deep match-3 expedition! Take a dive into the mine, search for your grandpa’s lost items, and collect precious stones to help the villagers around town rebuild Farnsbury. Reach the bottom of the old mine and become the Spelunk King (or Queen)!

title: New Yankee 8: Journey of Odysseus
description: Once again, Mary shatters the boundaries of time and space as she's practicing magic and sends herself and her husband, John, reeling back in time. They land on the outskirts of Troy, where they help the Greek hero Odysseus triumph in the legendary battle.

title: Traumatic Syndrome
description: Try to discover the identity of this unusual killer who has been unpunished for over a year in this unique investigative horror game!

title: Codename: Terranova
description:
One copy to play!
The purchase of a single copy of the game grants a friend free access to the Terranova Operating Central System () that involves him as an integral part of this new experience.
(By purchasing the game on Steam you will have access to the Agent role. The Operator role is freely and easily accessible from any smart device and requires an Agent to connect to)

Agent, do you read me?
Codename: Terranova is a two-players 3D co-op communication game.
Your team must beat the training on the Terranova experimental hovering train: this will prepare you to be the most reliable couple, the Field Agent (a.k.a Agent), and the Operations Center (a.k.a. Operator).

Co-op communication
Each mission will test the team's balance: will you be able to communicate efficiently?
As the Agent, you can operate on the train in person to handle devices and solve puzzles.
As the Operator, through the Terranova Operating Central System that can be used by smartphone or PC, you can interact with the Agent and the devices on the train.

title: KnotBot
description: From collecting buttons to solving tangled mazes, automate KnotBot on a quest of handcrafted puzzles. Solve the problems your own way, it's simple to understand but still deep and challenging.

title: Looking Glass
description:
Looking Glass is a free RPG horror-esque exploration game made with WOLF RPG Editor released in 2019.
It features a 4-chapter story centering Aoi Yuuta, who experiences reoccurring nightmares taking place in a different world. However, things begin to change with the appearance of someone with almost the exact same face as him.

title: Full Animal Party
description: Full Animal Party is a 4-Player party game in which you will have to compete against other party animal players in 35 different minigames and four board modes in order to be the crowned victor. Hooray!

title: Alexis Almighty: Daughter of Hercules
description: Chronos - the evil god of time casts a spell on Hercules and turns him into an old man!

title: Silent Sector
description: Silent Sector is a crazy sci-fi action rpg from a new distant Wild West dominated by powerful corporations locked in a fight for a rare mineral called Eldorite.

title: Please Hold Me
description: Please Hold Me is an interactive friend that really needs you. Meet Olivier, a lonely man that is in dire need of a new friend. You will be able to talk with him about a variety of different topics and forge a meaningful bond with him.

title: Nevertales: Hearthbridge Cabinet - Collector's Edition
description: Can you live up to your family’s legacy in time?

title: For Evelyn
description: An intriguing tale of love, betrayal, and the ultimate sacrifice.

title: Brothers in Blood
description: Wage war across some of the most iconic battles in WWII. Featuring exciting cooperative action with up to eight players and a feeling of large scale combat.

title: Jade Cicada
description: Jade Cicada is a puzzle game with mirror-like movement of figures where you have to simultaneously get two figures to certain areas along the way bypassing tricky enemies and ..... walls.

title: Total Arcade Racing
description: Total Arcade Racing is a fun 2D top-down arcade racing game where you zip around closed circuits. Play solo or with up to 8 friends on the same screen in various game modes.

title: Nimbatus: Drone Creator
description: Use the Nimbatus Drone Creator to construct physically simulated drones and try them out in a virtual testing environment. Do you have what it takes to become a drone engineer?

title: Haiku, the Robot
description: Enter a strange and unexplored land full of adorable robots, hidden secrets, and evil virus-infected machines. Discover different weapons, items, and abilities that will help you progress and discover new areas.

title: Are You A Wizard
description: Using magic is harder than it seems in old-school roguelike Are You A Wizard! Level up, explore procedurally generated stages, and battle scores of enemies using nothing but the spells you found lying on the floor! But what do the spells do? There's one way to find out!

title: Sentimental K
description: 'Sentimental K' is a 3D roguelike action game. Weapons, skills, artifacts, dungeon layouts, bosses change randomly every time you play. Try to make synergistic choices and enjoy the unexpected and challenging play!

title: Ostrova Koshki
description: Action platformer about teenage issues in primitive world

title: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat
description: The Adventures of Spunk Dodgers and Splat is a 2D auto-scrolling platformer featuring fast action and hilarious quips. Jump to avoid enemies and obstacles while collecting coins on the way to completing over 50 thrilling levels.

title: The Core Message
description: Combining retro puzzles and a arcade space shooter. You and your crew found strange materials in the galaxy core to upgrade your ship to the most powerful. While collecting core materials you came across something unbelievable ... The Core Message. The Core Message changes everything.

title: Marshmallow Tank
description: A tank simulation game，with cartoon style，battle royale，destory everything you can see!

title: My Lovely Wife
description: My Lovely Wife delves into the depths of a man’s grief after the sudden death of his beloved wife. Explore the notions of one’s willingness to do anything for love and the importance of letting go in this mix of dating, management, and alchemy simulators.

title: Super Bernie World
description: Join Bernie's movement and transform the United States in this free retro 2D platformer.

title: Groupthink
description: Groupthink is a party game about working together with your teammates to come up with silly answers - One letter at a time!

title: Lonely Arts
description: Let global players create arts freely. An art simulator to relax people's spirit and relieve pressure. We will gather the creativity of players around the world, and strive to create the most suitable platform for players to create.

title: Police Shootout
description: Police Shootout is a new turn-based FPS game. Put on your uniform and get ready to respond the most surprising calls in your policeman’s career. Solve cases and gain experience, but also find out why a good young policeman gave up his career in a big city and moved to a small town of San Adrino.

title: Aladdin: Hidden Objects Game
description: Uncover the secrets of the magical East in the newest hidden object game! Unexpected plot twists are guaranteed, so enjoy incredible adventures! Get some equipment and supplies, grab the map and go!

title: Gem Master
description: A colorful strategic game with simple rules, quick sessions, and increasingly challenging computer opponents. Beware of the Merciless!

title: Chasing Light
description: 'Chasing Light' is the story of the seven days of exploring the physical properties of a game and uncovering an inner world of human beings and society. Have a weird trip!

title: I'm on Observation Duty 2
description: Your job is to monitor live surveillance camera footage and spot anomalies in the monitored rooms. Anomalies range from furniture movement to otherworldly intruders. When you spot an anomaly you have to file a report to fix it. You will need sharp eyes and good memory to survive the entire night.

title: Final Upgrade
description: Help humanity to spread throughout the cosmos by exploring new worlds, building space factories and setting up trade routes. Research advanced technologies to increase efficiency and unlock new paths of development. Fight off other artificial intelligences in your goal to reach the Final Upgrade!

title: High Strategy: Urukon
description: Urukon is an experimental grand strategy game inspired by Euro-style board games. You play as one of 32 factions on a dying alien world. Each turn, you get to take just one of 10 actions. To achieve your chosen faction's goal, you'll need to carefully juggle multiple interactive systems.

title: Maze Burrow
description: An echidna wakes up one day to find its cozy burrow turned into a giant maze by an evil mole gang! Solve puzzles to progress through the burrow, defeat the mole gang, and escape to freedom in this Sokoban-inspired puzzler.

title: Clipped
description: The simple life of a duck may not be so simple after all.. Something terrible has happened and it is up to YOU to figure out what's wrong, but what lies ahead will be a serious challenge, the tiniest mistakes can be your biggest accidents.

title: Baby Shark VR Dancing
description: Indulge your kids in an underwater 360° adventure with Baby Shark!

title: Jelly Brawl
description: Jelly Brawl is a physics based multiplayer party game where you gotta flop, and pop your way to the top! Fight alone or against friends and experience the mayhem as you struggle to be the last jelly standing!

title: ReThink | Evolved 4
description: ReThink | Evolved 4 is a Puzzle Game in a futuristic setting, that features a variety of Puzzles that utilize Lasers and the behavior of light and it's colors. Use new gameplay mechanics to puzzle your way through the game's beautiful world.

title: SCP: 5K
description: SCP: 5K is an upcoming co-op tactical horror title where an anomalous branch of the FBI, known as the Unusual Incidents Unit respond to a distress signal from Area-12; a secret bio research facility specializing in supernatural anomalies for an organization called the SCP Foundation.

title: Saving Stages
description: Have you ever watched a rocket launch and land its own booster and thought "Wow I want to do that!" Well look no further, because you came to the right place!

title: Super Bounce Ball
description: Bounce balls and collect star on the platform, easy in early levels, but gets harder. There will be rotating saws that move which you must avoid. Shooting turrets that fire bullets that you need to dodge.

title: Minigame Blast
description: Grab your controllers and get ready to party, Minigame Blast is here! Play solo or up to 8 players in this minigame arcade experience. Explore 16 minigames in multiple game modes. Take on your friends in Versus or brave the games together in Cooperative.

title: Angle Wars
description: Angle Wars is a tactical top-down war game for one to four players, requiring quick reflexes and a keen eye for angles. Play through the co-op campaign, or go head-to-head in local play to destroy your enemies in a variety of game types.

title: Gutwhale
description: Gutwhale is a finite roguelite about managing the space between you and your ammo, while fighting your way through a digestive system!

title: Golden Fall 2
description: Golden Fall 2 is a single character dungeon crawl RPG focused on exploration of an engaging and diverse world. Combat follows a simultaneous turn-based system inspired by roguelikes.

title: TechnoTsunami
description: Solve puzzles to uncover the mysteries of a space cruise ship. Fight or work together with robots which are remotely controlled by humans on Earth. Collect the technology coming from the future which might cause an apocalypse. Save the future and the past before it's too late.

title: Shuffled Nightmares
description: The aim of this game is to rotate pieces of a shuffled puzzle, to reveal a Nightmare. Each level is more challenging than the previous one, with more parts of the puzzle shuffled, and introducing new behavior.

title: Somny & Yawn: Dream Detectives
description: Both players play as Somny & Yawn, two detectives who investigate the nightmare that invades the Islands of Dreams. With his sharp eyesight, Somny can find clues spread across the islands, while Yawn, thanks to her exceptional social skills, can discover the secrets of the inhabitants.

title: Race Maniacs
description: Take part in crazy races, where all the turns on the tracks at a right angle!

title: Life of a Mercenary
description: Lead a mercenary company seeking fame and fortune. Be honorable and help defend the kingdom or take contracts to those who pay the most. Rise to the top of the mercenary chain in this medieval story based around the events of The Great Tournament.

title: Beyond Enemy Lines: Remastered Edition
description: The world is near of nuclear apocalypse, a soviet seperatist group captured the control chip of a military satelite. It is your job to recover the chip! Equipped with state of the art weapons and equipment, you operate in absolute secrecy as a lone wolf far beyond enemy lines.

title: Family Mysteries 2: Echoes of Tomorrow
description: Get ready for thrilling sci-fi adventure in the big city, which offers riveting and refreshing approach to the hidden object puzzle adventure genre. "Family Mysteries 2: Echoes of Tomorrow" is an emotional cyberpunkish ride with a hint of romance that takes you straight into not-too-distant future.

title: Hooplord
description: Hooplord is a labor of love that combines boss battles and basketball into a hybrid VR experience that's unlike anything you've ever seen or played before.

title: Warshmallows
description: Battle online in a captivating four-player arena shooter with endless amounts of fun, Warshmallows! Take control of your favorite Warshmallow and hop, dash, loot and shoot to be the last one standing. Twist the time with automated bullet time, survive the chaotic catastrophes and collect the donuts!

title: PlugMax
description: Simple yet electric battles! Shockingly easy rules! Plug in to win! Show the world your Power with Plug Max!

title: Hidden Dream
description: “Hidden Dream” is a game about puzzle, exploration and collection in horizontal version. In this game, players are supposed to participate in the story about how did Princess Wencheng complete her journey to Tibet that for getting marry with Srongtsen Gampo in Princess Wencheng’s fantasy world.

title: Protective Clothing
description: Five people found themselves in a secluded, abandoned factory. Abducted for unknown reasons, the victims are faced with deadly traps as trust degrades by the minutes.

title: Cuyo
description: Cuyo is a relaxing, small platformer. Relax and play with relax mode or take a small challenge in normal mode.

title: Realpolitiks II
description: Lead your people to glory and write a new chapter of history in Realpolitiks II, a real-time grand strategy game where you lead any contemporary nation in an attempt to secure world dominance.

title: ENEFN
description: ENEFN is a strange school, something even more strange happened and only one of the students circulates in its corridors, you, satisfying the requests of those who can no longer move... make your journey in search of your freedom.

title: Falling Frontier
description: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields, construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.

title: Terracosmic
description: Terracosmic is a game where freedom of sandbox, survival, strategy and action are uniquely blended to deliver an unrepeated gaming experience.

title: Rollercoaster Mechanic
description: In Rollercoaster Mechanic, you save destroyed and broken funfairs. A small company, two brothers Leo and Noah, each with different skills and a great challenge: starting up broken rollercoasters and other attractions. Diagnose damage, repair, clean, test.

title: Døm Rusalok
description: Russia in the ‘90s. A provincial town at the edge of the crumbling Soviet Empire. A group of kids faces the disturbing horror they are unable to comprehend – the Døm Rusalok. This is a place where the worst nightmares come true.

title: Chesscake
description: Classic board game in a computer version. A variant of English drafts. The goal of the game is to collect all enemy checkers.

title: Ploid Saga
description: Ploid is a new platform adventure game for old or modern hardware, play and explore the lost temples, gain sacred disc files and become the ultimate Ploid X of the galaxy! + V.O.I.D.

title: Catovania
description: This is a game about a cat who fights with enemies. 2D platformer is made in a retro style.

title: Frogsong
description: Frogsong is a heartfelt adventure where it's okay to be small. You'll make new friends, explore beautiful environments, and embark on a journey to find your place in the world.

title: Sheepo
description:
Sheepo is a quirky metroidvania platformer featuring a shape-shifting sheep-thing, who must traverse an uncharted planet in order to collect samples of each living species for an intergalactic species database.

To capture a creature, Sheepo must find their unhatched egg, which happen to be highly guarded by that species "queen" (aka, a boss.) With each egg Sheepo collects, you then gain the ability to transform into that creature on contact, and explore the deeper reaches of the planets sprawling environment

Sheepo is a metroidvania, but contains no standard combat. Instead, gameplay is based on platforming and exploration. With the collection of each creature, Sheepo is able to dig, fly, and teleport across an interconnected series of landscapes, uncovering hidden shrines, old ruins, and strange characters.

title: Reflections of Life: Utopia - Collector's Edition
description:
You've been invited to the Mechanical Toys Fair! But your excitement quickly turns to dread when a toy-theater master kidnaps your mechanical flying companion! You're hot on his trail when you're thrown into a toy-theater world, inhabited by countless magical creatures and the darkness threatening to trap them all forever! Can you find the true toy master and escape with your newfound friends in time? Find out in this sensational Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

The Collector's Edition includes:
• Unearth the secrets of an ancient order while you race to rescue someone you love in the bonus game!
• Earn a variety of unique achievements!
• Tons of hidden feathers, coins, and morphing objects to find!
• Enjoy re-playable HOPs and mini-games, exclusive wallpapers, soundtrack, concept art, a hidden puzzle, theater, and more!
• Never get lost with the strategy guide!

title: Peaky Blinders: Mastermind
description: Peaky Blinders: Mastermind is a puzzle-adventure game, based on the multi-award-winning TV show. Become the Mastermind as you control key characters and pull off perfectly synchronized plans.

title: Utopias: Navigating Without Coordinates
description:
Utopias: Navigating Without Coordinates is a videogame network of nine worlds - each one a personal utopia developed by a member of AAA collective.
Is a collective utopia possible?

title: Trover Saves the Universe: Important Cosmic Jobs
description: In the Important Cosmic Jobs DLC, players can embark on a new adventure and explore Trover's workplace

title: Rance 4.1: Okusuri Koujou wo Sukue!
description: Rance 4.1 stars an indebted Rance and Athena 2.0 as they try to solve the mystery of the sudden monster attacks from underground that has stopped Happiness Pharmaceutical, the creators of the Seirogan, from producing their main brand of healing products. The prize for fixing the situation is 150,000 gold and Rance isn't the only one aiming for it.

title: Rance 4.2: Angel-gumi
description:
Rance 4.1 and Rance 4.2 are two parts of the same storyline, and use the same mechanics and artstyle. Part of the game involves navigating the Happiness Pharmaceutical office and Romance Park, speaking with people, and investigating the surroundings through an adventure game menu.

The other part is a dungeon-crawler taking place in the Angel Army secret underground base. Within the base, there are specific rooms where the player can interact with the environment, use healing items, and load/save. The rooms are connected to each other by thin routes, where the only available actions are "Advance" and "Retreat", to take a step forwards or backward. (Most routes are about 3-5 steps long). These paths are the spots where random encounters can occur. When the game starts, the base is unmapped, and paths are marked on menus as "???". Each time the player crosses a path and enters a new room, Athena 2.0 will draw the room on the map (with a short dialogue among the party Rance about how to name and illustrate it; sometimes giving comical or non-indicative names). If Athena is not present, Rance will try to draw the map himself. The "???" option will change to reflect the room name. Some paths are hidden or trapped, and can only be crossed later in the game.

title: Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot - A New Power Awakens: Part 1
description: Additional story content to Dragon Ball Z: Kakarot which sees Goku and Vegeta's training under Whis, along with a battle against the God of Destruction Beerus.

title: Kichikuou Rance
description: Kichikuou Rance (literally translating to "Brutal King Rance") is the seventh game in Alicesoft's flagship Rance Series. It was released in Japan on December 19, 1996. It was the first Alicesoft game to be produced for Windows 95 operating systems, as well as the first game to use the company's SYSTEM 35 engine and the territory conquest strategy gameplay used in several of its future releases.

title: CounterSide
description: CounterSide is a 2D strategic RPG developed by Studiobside. Players role-play as the boss of a private military company and lead their workers with superpowers to fight against various enemies.

title: Alfal's Grove
description:
Go fast. Tear out their hearts. Use them to... buy stuff.

Alfal's Grove is a first-person roguelike with push-forward combat, infinite item stacking, and a map that grows as you play. Kill enemies, take their hearts, give them to trees in exchange for their fruits.

And kill the king.

title: 11.45 A Vivid Life
description: A short weird tale about a girl who discovered her skeleton isn't hers, stole an xray machine and fled to the country to investigate her own body

title: Arengius
description:
Can you save the world from Arengius? 
The whole galactic federation is under attack by the gigantic organism known only as Arengius! Having created the Skeleton Robot army, it's bent on galaxy domination! With the federation army under attack on all fronts, only you have a chance to stop Arengius and save the galaxy! Pilot your space fighter through the enemy stronghold, stopping at nothing to annihilate these threats to all sentient life! 
 
There's a whole bunch of features! 
- 13 stages with unique hazards and design! 
- Engage powerful bosses, escalating from sand worms and giant slimes until you fight Arengius itself! 
- Amass enough turrets, options and sidecannons to cover the whole screen in bullets! But take care - all of them are lost if your ship explodes! 
- 6 ships with different armament and playstyle! 
- Newly written chiptune soundtrack using NES limitations for an authentic retro experience! 
- Does the game feel too lenient and easy? Turn off your shield and turn on Scatter mode! Every damage is lethal and you start each level without powerups! 
- Does the game feel too hard? Easy mode doubles your shield gauge and slows down the level scrolling, introducing enemies at a much more manageable pace!

title: Rance 5D: The Lonely Girl
description: Rance 5D: The Lonely Girl is the eighth game in Alicesoft's flagship Rance Series. It was released in Japan on October 25, 2002, almost six years after Kichikuou Rance, marking the longest time span between the release of two Rance games.

title: Rance VI: Collapse of Zeth
description:
Rance VI -The Collapse of Zeth- is the ninth installment of the Rance Series.
Despite the fact that 5D was released earlier, Rance VI is usually considered the beginning of the new Rance timeline set after Kichikuou Rance, due to the much bigger scale of the game along with the fact that it takes place in LP0004, leaving the year LP0003 where Kichikuou Rance would have taken place as "the missing year", since the canonical events of that year weren't adapted into games. It was also from this point that many details of the lore and the setting were better established and given further detail.

title: Brutal Rage
description: BRUTAL RAGE is a scrolling beat’em up. Cross the city and beat all enemies on your way. Use your skills and weapons to realize epic combo ! When you’re ready use your rage to crush your enemies. Discover the story of cops wrongly accused for a crime they didn’t commit ! Embark on a brutal path of blood for retribution. Escape from the prison and prove your innocence. Find out who trapped you !

title: Escape Initiative
description: Run, jump, and shoot lasers in this difficult and aesthetic action precision platformer. Built for fast play but not required, you will enjoy hand built levels with an immense variety of challenges. Customize your colors and realize your initiative. ESCAPE.

title: The Test: Hypothesis Rising
description: The second chapter in The Test trilogy. Answer a series of in-depth questions to reveal hidden truths about yourself and unlock secrets to discover how your life can change drastically with just a few, slight modifications. ...But are you sure you want the answers you seek?

title: Sakura Stars
description: When hordes of Youkai threaten the world, the Tanukis send a messenger to choose human girls to receive magical powers to defend humanity. They are known as SAKURA STARS. This is a horizontal shmup made on Pico-8, a retro fantasy console with purposeful limitations to simulate an 8-bit era console.

title: Haunted by Evil
description: Creepy nightmares becoming a reality and making Patrick’s life (a usual IT-developer) full of trials. What’s that: creepy horror or usual schizophrenia? You have to solve the mystery and make a move to unravel the mysterious events and issues surrounding Patrick’s life.

title: Frog Bath
description: Bathe your Frog King by jumping, hopping and tonguing yourself around maps in Frog Bath with the goal of beating your friends at giving His Cleanliness a bath! Spit and steal bath items from your friends to give the best bath possible to the Frog King.

title: Goodbye Dreaming
description: A visual novel dating simulator following Robin as she discovers herself and escapes her mother's shadow. Set in college this otome game features six romanceable characters, but be careful: not everyone has Robin's best interests at heart.

title: Apprentice Knight-Iona
description: Take up the mantle of an Apprentice Knight Iona in this Action-RPG game on her quest to be part of the Brave Hero’s Party. Failing the knighthood examination, you must now train with your master to prove yourself worthy.

title: Bad Run: Turbo Edition
description: Bad Run is a spin-off of Bad Pad, featuring a casual action packed, runner metroidvania platformer.

title: Daiichi Dash
description: Following the destruction of her hometown by a tsunami and the ensuing nuclear fallout, twelve-year-old Aiko travels to Tokyo to punish those allegedly responsible for her home's destruction.

title: Way of Boy: Another Way
description: Way of Boy: Another Way is a 2D action-adventure game in the series “Way of Boy”. You will plunge again into the so-called "Alternative Russia" in the shoes of the new protagonist, which is the exact opposite of the former. This will be reflected not only in the plot, but also in the gameplay, as you run in an opposite direction, an atypical direction for most platformers.

title: Godless Tactics
description: Lead an elite strike team through the wars of a reborn civilisation, and decide the fate of humanity through your achievements and choices. Traverse a dynamic war-map, engage in fast, turn-based battles, and explore the world of 2952.

title: Bigwig Flint
description: Bigwig Flint is a challenging, thrilling, and hilarious top down shooter. A soulfully crafted game with emphasis on perfect classic retro gameplay. Waldemar, the circumcised square, must fight against Bigwig Flint and his many allies. At stake is not only the Universe, but also your sanity.

title: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII
description: Xuan-Yuan Sword VII is an ARPG rooted in Chinese history and mythology. Players take on the role of Taishi Zhao, a calm and reliable swordsman who was accidentally involved in a tragic fate. To protect his beloved family, he starts a journey in this chaotic realm to find the truth.

title: Adventures of JQ Jones: "Isle of the Serpent Empress"
description: An action, adventure, stealth, VR maze crawler game. Explore and help JQ Jones collect gems, Serpent's eggs, hidden door knobs and keys to open gates. Battle against the enemies to pass through each levels by using your longbow, sword and Shuriken blade.

title: Sarawak
description: Literary mystery game set in Oxford and Borneo.

title: Laser Heck
description: Laser Heck is an arcade-style space shooter that could be described as "Bullet-Heck Asteroids". Defend a space station against an invading fleet by yourself or with 4 Player Split-Screen Coop, or have some fun with your friends by playing the Deathmatch, Keep Away, and Racing mini-games.

title: You are next
description: "You are next" is a murder mystery for Virtual Reality. Gather your detective instinct and identify the killer!

title: Ourea
description: Ourea is a Cinematic Puzzle game about discovering the harrowing past of a long-forgotten world. Play as the last of the Oreads and unravel the mysterious history of your people.​

title: Swamp Castle
description: Finally decided to release a second beta of this piece of crap map (gameplay wise) I'm not sure I'll ever finish it.

title: Escape Point
description: “Players are not the only ones that are after you.” Out-Break in the prison turned the guards and the prisoners into zombies. You must save yourself from various zombies coming for you.

title: Apocalypse Age: Destruction
description: This is a classic top-down shooter with top-down gameplay. You are a solider who is looking for the truth, fighting agains monsters to save the world. This is survive game , kill or be kill.

title: Garlic
description: A retro-style video game set in a manga-ish absurd world.

title: Dragon and Weed: Origins OB - Dual Edges
description: In 2053, war is big money. When biotech searchers are abducted, two skilled mercenaries have to extract them. To accomplish their mission, they’ll have to face the n°1 private army. Dive into this world without mercy for a thrilling action story.

title: Trash Punk
description: Rock the apocalypse in punk style!

title: InfiniteCorp
description: The 2190 year. You are an employee of a corporation dealing in goods distribution and logistics in the “megatower” – the place where all local citizens live. Find yourself in the cyberpunk reality by playing InfiniteCorp, a decision-based strategy card game!

title: Rance Quest
description:
Rance Quest is the 11th game in the Rance Series.
Unlike its predecessor, Rance Quest is not a strategy conquest game - instead, it is a role-playing game similar to Rance VI, but tweaked to include features from Sengoku Rance and Toushin Toshi 3. It includes 3D graphics for both dungeon exploration and enemy display in battle, using a first person view battle system.

title: Kill Yourself
description: Enough with games where death is a nuisance that must be avoided at all costs: in Kill Yourself, death is your goal! But beware, it won't be easy: you'll need to work hard to find all the different ways to end the guy's miserable life.

title: Sole Iron Tail
description: Sole Iron Tail is a momentum-based platformer, based around sliding and charging with your tail as fast as your can!

title: Wire up!
description:
Help robots to party!
Wire up! - is an indie game, where you connect robots, so they could party!

Shoot wires, connect robots, play for the score!

title: Scoot Kaboom and the Tomb of Doom
description: Scoot Kaboom and the Tomb of Doom is a fiendishly fun action platformer that all takes place on one enormous screen. Run, dive and dodge through the twisting maze, evading spikes, saws, fireballs, portals and even more and escape the Tomb of Doom!

title: Visceratum
description: Provocative game-experiment. Say "Hi" to your own viscera...

title: The Pope: Power & Sin
description: Take on the role of the Pope, strengthen the authority of the Church State, fight for spiritual and political independence from pagans and the renewal of church structures. The rule of Pope is a torrent of numerous scandals, excesses and signs of moral corruption in the authorities of the Church.

title: Sliptime Sleuth
description: In Sliptime Sleuth, play as a P.I. with a twist. In this time-traveling puzzle game, utilize your handy gadget to take on a variety of contract work, slipping through time in order to earn an honest buck.

title: Toxastra
description: Toxastra is a science fiction top-down shooter-RPG where you take control of Dale Custer - the chief of security aboard the CFV Janus, a ship of colonization mining. After an explosion that has plunged you into a coma, you wake up in the chaos of the ship invaded by mutants.

title: Unlock the King 3
description: New sequel of the successful Unlock The King, now with 3D boards based on Rubik's Cubes. A originally designed puzzle game inspired by Chess. Move the pieces and create a path to Unlock the King.

title: Bloom: The Forest Burns
description: The dreklings have been drawn to the forest and they are threatening everything with their fires! You must find help and stop them before it's too late in this action adventure RPG.

title: Hell to Raze
description: Play as the Prince of Hell in this Hack and Slash top-down platformer. Fighting to reclaim his throne after being framed for his fathers' murder, the prince uses his sword to grapple and swing through hell; slaying any demons that get in his way.

title: Roller Riot
description: Get your revenge on the enemy cyborg roller derby gang! Roll and fight through a beautiful neon cityscape as CB, a genetically modified cyborg, bent on getting revenge for her past...

title: The Painted Forest
description: You wash ashore as a castaway to come upon the painted forest, a fossil forest in a distant world, and the lost temples of the people that once worshiped it.

title: Whisper
description: Whisper is a chilling first-person horror game set in a haunted mansion filled with dark secrets and eerie whispers. As an investigator, explore the shadowy corridors, solve haunting puzzles, and uncover the tragic past of Whisper Manor. Will you survive the terror within?

title: Madden NFL 21
description: Go all out in Madden NFL 21 where a fearless new generation of rising NFL stars is poised to change the game. Packed with fresh new features and innovative gameplay enhancements, Madden NFL 21 delivers new levels of ingenuity and control developed to inspire creativity on and off the field.

title: Rance 01: Quest for Hikari
description:
This game is a remake of the 1989 classic, the first Rance game ever made 25 years ago. The gameplay system, graphics and everything else was revamped (on a much larger scale than they were for Rance 02) and will be a product by itself rather than being a part of a compilation such as Alice's Cottage.

Just like the original though, the game heavily features classic ADV-like interaction with the environment and characters (look, touch, etc.) and 8-10 hours in length.

title: Rance 02: The Rebellious Maidens
description:
Rance II: Rebellious Maidens is the second game of the Rance Series, remade in 2009 and released in Alice 2010. The game is a turn-based dungeon crawler RPG with a top-down interface. Throughout the game, Rance may gain new party members, though further customization, such as organizing equipment, are unavailable for some.

The remake released in 2010 is nothing but a graphical update, retaining the exact same gameplay, storyline, script and engine to the ones used in the original Rance II from 1990, so any pages related directly to Rance II will use information and images from the remade version for better visuals.

title: Rance 03: The Fall of Leazas
description:
Rance 03 is a remake of the Rance III classic, featuring completely new art, an updated scenario, and a revised system. Much comparable with those of the Rance 01 remake.

The gameplay has been completely revamped featuring a unique dungeon system with several playable characters unlockable over the course of the game and the story changed in some ways to better adapt to the current plot of the on-going games.

title: Heartworm
description: Pass through the threshold and enter a world born of memories. Defend yourself with a camera while solving death’s mysteries in a reverent evolution of 90’s survival horror, integrating both fixed cameras and over the shoulder perspectives.

title: Pagan Hope
description:
Pagan Hope is a PC/Windows hybrid rpg between roguelike and hack and slash gameplay types. It can be played straight-through as most of the maps are connected with constant paths, but there are also maps where the feeling of randomizing will be present.

The plot: A great wizard summons a portal that connects the humans` realm with the unknown realm of Ja`han. A fierce demon, ruler over Ja`han that came through the portal, takes the sorcerer`s body and starts a quest to conquer the humans` souls. A young sorcerer is sent to retrieve some magical tablets that can block the portal.

title: Little Vampire
description: Little Vampire is an adventure-style visual novel (ADV) published in Japan by AliceSoft's predecessor company, Champion Soft, in 1988. It is the direct sequel to Little Princess, and continues the adventures of Kurusu Miki and Ogawa Kentarou after their escape from Dracula's Castle. The events of the game would later be retconned into the timeline of the Rance series, with Dracula developing into the Demon King Gi, and the game's central antagonist, Ramon C. Burksham becoming one of the earliest-appearing Dark Lords.

title: Chucky Mendoza and the Curse of the Pharaoh
description: Chucky Men­doza and the Curse of the Pharaoh is a charm­ing old school plat­former inspired by 80's 8-bit retro games on clas­sic com­put­ers. Run across screen, jump over obsta­cles, col­lect trea­sures through­out a cursed pyra­mid, avoid trip­mines, lava pits and var­i­ous deadly ene­mies (includ­ing bats, mum­mies, bugs, cobras) along the way.

title: Paper Mario 3D Land
description: Paper Mario 3D Land is a fangame that is inspired by the many games in the Paper Mario series. It has visuals inspired by the original Paper Mario, combat system similar to Super Paper Mario, 3D environments and movement like in Paper Mario: Sticker Star and gameplay mechanics based on Super Mario 3D Land and Super Mario 3D World.

title: Psycho Waluigi
description: Psycho Waluigi is a platformer fangame featuring Waluigi and his newly discovered psychic powers in the world of Unconcia. The protagonist must endure through over 30 kingdoms using the mechanics related to its psycho powers.

title: Super Slyder
description: Direct an adorable ball named Slyder through a thrilling set of mazes. You guessed it... the blue lovable hero is back with an all-new addictive adventure containing level-altering items, 9 unique characters, and hilarious animations. This new slippery version also comes with 280+ challenging levels and an easy-to-use level editor. Play the levels at your own pace with level-skipping ability. Let the stress fall away as you slide into this fun adventure!

title: Super Smash Bros. Crusade
description: Super Smash Bros. Crusade is a fangame of Super Smash Bros., with new characters, stages, movesets, items, music and game modes.

title: Viktor Crysworth
description: Viktor Crysworth is an intelligence-based science fiction visual novel that has managed to extend from the Federal Security Service to the Kazakh Foreign Intelligence Service.

title: Memoria
description: Memoria is a classic memory matching game designed for Windows 3.1. Players are presented with a grid of face-down tiles, each holding a pictogram. The Objective is to find all matching pairs by flipping two tiles at a time.

title: Iron Vulture
description: Iron Vulture is a real-time strategy line defender. You can command six soldiers in real-time combat, move them across lanes, and use their abilities to eliminate wave after wave of mutated creatures.

title: The Last Monsters
description: The monster collecting and battling game that finally grew up with you. In a world with a mature setting, experience a hybrid real time combat system, monster customization and survival elements that take the genre to the next level.

title: Wild West Steam Loco
description: Fully functional model railway building game in Wild West style. Create and paint the landscape, place the tracks, steam engines and wagons. Start the trains and create control sequences to direct them to the right tracks.

title: AnShi
description:
Grab your hoverboard and explore the ancient, mysterious world of AnShi as you glide across caves, large deserts and old temple ruins to discover its secrets.
With the company of an energy being you explore this vast world together. Discover what happened to the planet and its being. Featuring stunning visuals and
an original soundtrack, AnShi delivers a relaxing, unique, breathtaking experience.

title: Monuments Flipper
description: BECOME A MONUMENT RENOVATOR. Monuments flipper is a game in which you play the role of a professional monument renovator. You choose from among the world's greatest monuments, restore them to their former glory and learn about history and architecture.

title: False Myth
description: Play as Rouge, the new bodyguard of the city's governor! Join Rita in her newly formed Justice Guild, where you'll handle the citizens' troubles, gather information about mysterious happenings, meet colorful characters, and explore the multiple districts of Lylan.

title: Saint Emiliana
description: After Emiliana's sister is captured in a Witch Hunt, she offers up her soul to a demon in order to gain the power of a Witch. Now she must wrestle with her faith as she searches for her sister.

title: A Week in the Cold
description: Traverse the cold slippery ice by sliding and skating while trying to avoid both pesky penguins and ghostly wolves. All the while moving between campfires trying to stay warm.

title: HeroTower
description: "Hero Tower" is a game without regular monsters where you directly face challenging bosses. Dodge the boss's attacks through rolling and jumping, and seize the opportunity to counter-attack. It tests players' reflexes, stamina management, and insight into the boss's moves.

title: Who Stole My Beard?
description: Inspired by classic point-and-click adventure games of the past, Who Stole My Beard is a casual game suitable for all ages! Your beard has been stolen! You and your loyal dog Leo must investigate the people and places of Beardsville to solve the crime. Uncover conspiracies, find new beards, and don't forget to pick up the groceries in this charming town of bearded intrigue.

title: Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2
description: The most comprehensive fishing game of all time! Immerse yourself in the virtual world of fishing and test yourself in the fishing technique of your choice! Feeder, fly fishing, spinning or classic float fishing - the choice is yours!

title: Nimby Rails
description: Design and run your own railroads for the real world. Fix global transportation dilemmas. Unleash your inner railway engineer and transit policy manager.

title: Dreamshard
description: Dreamshard is a rogue-like deck-building game where slay the spire meets hearthstone. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, fight monsters, craft a unique deck and defeat your enemies to find the secret of the Dreamshard.

title: Skycat
description: Cat vs Mouse! It's kawaii shoot'em up!

title: Cat in the Box
description: Cat in the Box is a charming platformer and puzzle adventure where creativity, timing, and strategy are the keys to success. Play as an adorable cat and overcome challenging levels by pushing boxes, solving puzzles, avoiding hazards, and finding the key required to unlock the exit of each stage.

title: Swordshot
description: Swordshot is a retro inspired casual sword shooter. Break through the cycle of rotating enemy protectors. Be fast, be patient, be smart and land the final blow.

title: Song of Iron
description: Song of Iron is a moody and provoking action adventure. A dive into a dark Nordic world full of mystery and danger. Your journey will take you far across the land of myths toward the home of the gods. Fight your way through man, monster and nature itself to reach the end.

title: VideoHole: Episode 1
description: VideoHole is an episodic first person adventure game set in an alien dimension. Meet new allies, find gadgets and uncover the mysteries of an ancient power far below your local video store.

title: Radarjam
description: Radarjam consists of the constant unpredictability of your enemy's location. Dodge what you can't see in your radar equipped fighter! But beware, the enemy advances at every step! Dogfight with enemy Fighters, Hellmakers, Heat Seekers, Carriers, Bombers and more! Unlock new ships with each run that can devastate your enemy with entirely different shooting and movement mechanics!

title: Capybara Carbonara
description: Trapped in a Zoo which cooks and prepares its own animals to serve up, Capy the mischievous Capybara is ready to cause mayhem and destruction to take the Zoo down in this wacky adventure!

title: Land of Zympaia
description: You start as a homeless person in the world, alone and with nothing in hand you have to work your way up to survive.

title: Ashina: The Red Witch
description: Get ready for adventure not like any other! This story is about Ash. An ordinary girl who takes an unexpected journey through the mysterious spirit world filled with strange creatures.

title: First Snow
description: On the day the first snow fell, I fell in love with her at first sight. The days when the first snow falls, she and I get closer... First Snow is a full-voice visual novel about a 20-year-old protagonist's first love.

title: Andarigas
description: The year is 2497 and Galactic civilization is in danger! Invaders from beyond the universe have started pouring out of tears in space and time and are beginning an assault on Earth, the heart of civilization throughout the galaxy.

title: Ultimate Truco
description: Ultimate Truco is a competitive simulator of the famous classic of the deck called "Truco" or as it is called by the French "Truc".

title: Pity Pit
description:
Dig your doom!
Procedural 2D platforming goes vertical as you dig, mine, craft and bomb your way downward! Take the role of Oratio, a Dwarf who enjoys hanging around the mines with his dear wife, until a demon spawns from a nearby pit and carries her away! Now it’s a race through the mines to get her back. Can you save Gwendoline from the Devil Johnson?

title: Core Decay
description: Explore vast facilities across a dying Earth and uncover a sinister plot to preserve humanity no matter the cost - even if it means redefining what makes us alive - in an atmospheric immersive sim that explores the nature of consciousness and individuality.

title: Radio Station
description: Radio Station is a single-player first-person game in which you have to get out of the existing situation.

title: Man Face Spider I
description: Hardcore and retro classic fixed shooter games, like space invaders. It have an old CRT monitor effect. Very exciting and impressive. Man face Spiders are evil aliens,you will kill all of them.

title: Fairy Fire: Defender of the Fairies
description: Up for some retro arcade action? Extra weapons, upgrades, smart bombs etc are your favorite tools? Then this great arcade clone is for you! Survive waves of evil creatures in this fantastic, fast paced side scroller. If you like games like Defender, Data Storm or Drop Zone, you will LOVE Fairy Fire!

title: Cork the Volcano
description: Join Rus the Dinosaur, Hippo the Hedgehog, and Syd the Sloth, to put a stop to whoever's causing the volcano of Pear Island to erupt!

title: Ponpu
description:
Get ready to break some eggs in this frantic multiplayer party-game! Ponpu mixes classic gameplay with new crazy mechanics, all packaged in one of the coolest art-styles ever seen!

Features:
- A fresh take on a classic game concept
- An epic campaign with massive bosses
- Hectic 4-player multiplayer with three game modes:

1. Deathmatch – Last Ponpu standing wins!
2. Coin Steal – Hoard the most coins before the time is up. Dragon style!
3. Paint Battle – Paint the town red! (or you know… whichever color you prefer)

- The most epic egg-based arsenal ever witnessed!

title: Mindframe: The Secret Design - Collector's Edition
description: Could you survive a deadly game where your opponent knew your secrets?

title: Battle Ram
description: "Battle Ram" is a fun arcade game about a Battle Ram who fights against robots.

title: Black Blood
description: Escape a quarantined hospital haunted by a dark entity. A short but gripping horror experience blending puzzles, action, and cinematic QTEs that will test your courage.

title: Mirastell
description: Mirastell is a 2D adventure game with a unique flavor of turn-based combat, set on a mysterious, abandoned space cruise liner. Discover what lead to the fate of the passengers, and earn weapons and items by exploring, and defeating enemies.

title: Snake Core
description: Are you ready to command a range of different units as they battle aliens in a mission-based take on the classic Snake? Select your path to victory!

title: Swatch Out!
description: Discover all the colors in the Art Zone by surrounding creatures the same color as you! Make yourself red, blue, or yellow, and discover how to become orange, green, and purple in this action title.

title: Ruin Raiders
description: Ruin Raiders is a turn-based tactical roguelike in which you command military squads on a no return journey into the ruins of an ancient civilization. Master turn-based combat, craft new technologies and deepen yourself further into the ever-shuffling ruins to unveil the past!

title: Cooking Companions
description: Solve the mystery deep in the woods of the Tatras Mountains. Will you butter someone up first? Or will you wind up on the chopping block?

title: Maggie's Movies: Second Shot
description: Become a movie director and help Maggie survive her second shot at fame, as she directs her first feature-length pirate movie!

title: The Cold War Era 2
description: The Cold War Era 2 is a PC strategy game based on the historical conflict between the USA and the USSR. You are able to take control of one of two superpowers and lead your country to victory in ideological combat and war.

title: Saturn Quest: Shadow of Planetus
description: Saturn Quest: Shadow of Planetus is a shameless 8-bit style clone of Shadow of the Colossus! You are Captain Navigator. Fight the evil minions of Planetus! Save Saturn! Save Galaxy!

title: Lucen
description: Explore unknown lands and fight mythical beasts on a quest to ask the old gods to restore light to your village. Harness light with your sword and bow to cut down your foes, and discover ancient secrets.

title: Spies & Soldiers
description: Spies & Soldiers is a game of strategy and subterfuge that plays out across watercolor maps of a procedurally generated kingdom. Seize control of castles and cities as each your empire expands across each new world, but be sure to keep in mind the balance of power.

title: Dog Trainer
description: Dog Trainer lets you experience all the joy and challenges of owning a dog. Create an unbreakable bond with your pup, watch him grow by your side and help him become the best - whatever it means to you!

title: Palladium: Adventure in Greece
description: In this game you will play as an archaeologist who is driven by a desire to find an ancient artifact. The hero will travel to Greece to solve riddles and avoid hazardous traps. But he is not the only one who wishes to obtain the treasure. Two other adventurers also arrive at the forgotten island.

title: What the Pho: restaurant startup stories
description: What the Pho: Roguelike restaurant startup! is an upcoming cooking/simulation game about creating your own dream restaurant, participate in competition and become the best chef in the city. Design, cook, server, get money, upgrade and repeat. Support single-player and coop up to 4 players.

title: Dreamjob: Programmer
description: A programmer's career sim. Acquire actual coding skills while playing! Learn programming from zero, earn skill points, change your office, create devices and games with visual programming. Our code learning game is a perfect introduction to Python, C++, C#, Java, or JavaScript.

title: Once Upon an Electric Dream
description: Princess Rosavel is on a deep space mission but can’t quite remember her purpose. Can she recollect her memories and find out why she went on such a dangerous journey?

title: Death Upon An Austrian Sonata: A Dana Knightstone Novel
description:
Return to Europe in a brand new adventure as Dana Knightstone, the best-selling novelist who can see ghosts. When your cousin, famed musician Sebastian Knightstone, starts hearing eerie violin music in his Austrian manor, he asks for your help to investigate. But you're not the only one digging up the ghost's secrets -- and you find yourself falling headlong into danger! Solve challenging puzzles as you trek through snowy Austrian landscapes in search of missing clues. Can you follow the ghost's trail before time runs out?
The Collector’s Edition includes:

Bonus gameplay
Smart strategy guide
Wallpaper & concept art
Replayable cutscenes

title: Royal Envoy 3: Collector's Edition
description: Discover new islands to develop in Royal Envoy 3 Collector's Edition! Fish, pearls, gold and ancient pirate treasures are waiting for you to find them. Journey across 11 islands and conquer over 80 time management levels. It's an incredible new adventure in this hit series. The CE contains 32 levels on 4 bonus islands - that's 15 islands and 114 levels total. Get wallpapers, the soundtrack and a walkthrough. Play Royal Envoy 3 Collector's Edition today!

title: It's Hard Being a Meatball
